items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: The mention of 'Baby Bruce' occurs entirely within [INTERVIEWER] turns ('Baby Bruce showed the television about him', 'Baby Bruce the piano player?'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to or acknowledge this specific mention, nor does the interviewee mention Bruce in their own turns.

ctx.x: What's that trumpet player now, Mr. Leroy, a meter on between Santa and Albany, Bill Slater? Oh, okay. Willie Webber. He used to play Trevor. I thought you meant to have him.
Maybe Bruce was telling us about him.

Yeah, that's right. I thought you meant Hal Michael, you used to play trumpet too. No, no, no. Yeah, I know you mean a stout little stuff fella. Tall, he'd be a slave, he's a good trumpet player. Yeah, yeah, Baby Bruce showed the television about him. Baby Bruce the piano player? Yeah. Oh, I seen him in a good one. He's got a record going back in front of that.
